confirm_delete_attendance: Are you sure you want to delete this attendance record?
attendance_policy_desc: One active policy at a time — set the shift, grace and deduction rules, and how many days payroll uses to calculate monthly salary. Replacing it keeps the previous version in history.
attendance_policy_note: This screen is for HR configuration (frontend demo). Values are stored in local storage and do not sync to the server yet.
policy_weekly_holiday_hint: Select fixed weekly off days (e.g. Friday & Saturday).
policy_core_rules_title: Late arrival, early leave & short day
policy_core_rules_intro: Single threshold for both directions: arriving late or leaving early by at least the set minutes counts as one breach (unless a manager approves). If someone works fewer hours than the minimum, the day is treated as leave.
policy_half_day_threshold: Half-day threshold — late or early by at least (minutes)
policy_short_day_hours: Count day as leave if worked hours are under (hours)
policy_late_early_timing_hint: Effective minutes usually include scheduled late grace and early-leave rules above—payroll should use one consistent rule for check-in vs start and checkout vs end.
policy_violation_treatment: When late/early threshold is breached (no manager approval)
policy_priority_hint: Application order: (1) Manager-approved late or early checkout → full day present. (2) Worked hours under the minimum → leave for that day. (3) Otherwise, late or early beyond the threshold → half day or salary deduction as selected.
policy_manager_early_present: If manager approves early checkout: mark present (full day)
policy_manager_late_present: If manager approves late arrival: mark present (full day)
policy_row_leave_under_hours: Net worked hours for the day are under {{h}} hours
policy_row_late_early_threshold: Late by at least {{n}} minutes after scheduled start, or early checkout by at least {{n}} minutes before scheduled end — without manager approval
policy_row_manager_early_approved: Early checkout with documented manager approval
policy_row_manager_late_approved: Late arrival with documented manager approval
policy_overtime_intro: OT accrues only after the standard working window and the grace below. Caps and approval keep payroll predictable.
policy_ot_grace: Minutes after standard length before OT starts
policy_ot_need_approval: OT must be approved by manager after it is worked (or exception process)
policy_ot_pre_approval: Planned OT requires pre-approval where possible
policy_ot_weekend: Different rules can apply on weekly-off days (flag for payroll handbook)
policy_comp_off: Compensatory time off (time off in lieu) allowed in place of OT pay when policy allows
policy_ot_bullet_1: System rounds down to the minimum block; fragments below the block are ignored unless HR overrides in payroll.
policy_ot_bullet_2: Daily cap trims excess; weekly cap applies across the payroll week.
policy_ot_bullet_3: Published multiplier is applied to eligible base components per payroll rules.
policy_internal_notes: Notes visible only on this policy page (local)
policy_tracking_hours_only_hint: Payroll respects total worked hours versus the daily target below. Planned start/end are reference only.
policy_target_hours_hint: Expected productive hours per day (used especially in “hours-only” mode and for overtime).
policy_late_warning_only_hint: When enabled, no half-day, leave or salary logic runs for schedule breaches. Employees are counted present; attendance issues only raise warnings.
policy_grace_gate_intro: Within grace minutes after planned start/end, attendance stays Present with informational flags Late, Early or Late+Early. No salary deduction — only warnings. Past grace minutes, downstream rules decide half-day vs leave.
policy_behalf_hours_title: After grace breach — hours decide outcome
policy_behalf_hours_leave: If net worked hours are below this threshold the day counts as Leave when the shift window is breached after grace.
policy_behalf_hours_half_intro: If net worked hours are at or above the same threshold, the breach is treated as Half-day instead of Leave.
policy_ot_intro_short: When enabled, excess time versus target working hours rolls into overtime at the multiplier below.
policy_live_late_warnings: Late / early warnings only — no sanction rules
policy_live_full_rules: Grace → Present+flags • Breach→ half-day vs leave by hours • Approvals honoured
policy_row_grace_presence_flags: Start/end within grace: Present with Late / Early / Late+Early flags (warnings only, no deductions)
policy_row_after_grace: After grace: Late or Early beyond grace — if worked {{h}}+ h → Half-day, else Leave (unless approval)
policy_row_hours_only_target: Hours-only mode: compare net hours to daily target {{h}} h; breaches use the same approvals and OT settings
policy_grace_row_outcome: Present; flags Late, Early or Late+Early. Warnings only — no salary deductions in this zone.
policy_type_hint: Choose a type to load suggested defaults. You can adjust every field below.
policy_always_present: Mark present regardless of arrival time
policy_always_present_hint: When enabled, employees are always marked present. Grace time and late/early deductions do not apply.
policy_grace_section_hint: Shown only when the option above is off. Employees get a daily grace window before late/early minutes are deducted.
policy_deduction_per_minute: Salary deduction per minute (beyond grace window)
policy_shift_working_hours_hint: Auto-calculated from start, end, and break. You can override manually.
policy_ot_rate_hint: Applied on top of each employee's designation-defined base overtime rate when overtime falls on a weekly-off or holiday.
policy_deduction_hint: Each late/early minute beyond the daily grace window is deducted from salary.
policy_preview_always_present: Every check-in is marked Present — no grace window or salary deductions.
policy_preview_grace: Daily grace: {{late}} min late · {{early}} min early check-in/leave.
policy_preview_deduction: {{amount}} deducted per late/early minute beyond the daily grace window.
policy_preview_manager_on: Manager approval enabled — approved late arrival or early leave can count as full-day Present.
policy_preview_manager_late: Approved late arrival → full day Present.
policy_preview_manager_early: Approved early leave → full day Present.
policy_preview_manager_off: Manager approval off — late/early follows grace and deduction rules only.
policy_preview_ot: Overtime enabled at {{rate}}× multiplier after target hours.
policy_manager_section_hint: After grace rules apply, a documented manager approval can override penalties for that day.
policy_manager_enable: Allow manager approval for late / early exceptions
policy_manager_late_present: Approved late arrival → mark full day Present
policy_manager_early_present: Approved early leave → mark full day Present
policy_salary_days_hint: Number of days used to divide monthly salary (e.g. 30 calendar days or 26 working days). Per-day and per-minute deductions use this base.
policy_preview_salary_days: Payroll divides monthly salary by {{days}} day(s).
no_shifts_available: No shifts available — add one in Shifts first
previous_policies_desc: Policies that have been replaced remain here for reference.
replace_current_notice: This will replace "{{name}}" as the active policy — it will move to Previous Policies.
